如何添加和切换模型？: How do I add and switch models?
首次使用填写服务商提供的接口类型、地址和密钥，获取模型后选择并保存。以后从输入框: Enter your provider's API type, URL, and key, then fetch and select a model. Switch models below the composer. “Add model” lets you reuse a provider and search or enter an ID; “Add provider” saves a new connection. Choose a model with tool calling.
会话保存在哪里？刷新会怎样？: Where are conversations saved? What happens on reload?
扩展会话保存在本机，按完整域名分组，同域的路径、查询参数和标签页共享列表，模型配: The extension saves conversations locally by hostname, sharing the list across paths and tabs. Model settings are shared across sites. Enabled tabs restore after reload; page actions still need an available target tab. Clicking the bookmark after reload opens a blank chat or resumes unfinished work. History remains in the list, but concurrent bookmark tabs may have separate records. Neither mode syncs to the cloud or merges with the other.
如何管理会话和主题？: How do I manage conversations and appearance?
顶部可新建对话、新开窗口和切换会话，新窗口使用空白会话并继承模型配置。标题在首轮: Use the header to start a chat, open a window, or switch conversations. New windows inherit your model settings. Titles are generated after the first reply; a ring marks running tasks. Use the trash icon to delete a conversation after stopping its task. In Pi settings, choose Auto, Light, or Dark. Auto follows the page or browser. Settings are grouped into General, Instructions, and Execution.
如何跨标签页协作？: How do agents work across tabs?
从 Chrome 工具栏的 Pi Tab 扩展图标启动。Agent 可用 tab: Start Pi Tab from the Chrome toolbar. Agents can use tab_open to create a tab and conversation, tab_send to assign tasks, and tab_read to read results. In bookmark mode, agent_spawn creates a conversation on the current page. Installing the extension does not add tab tools to bookmark sessions.
可以发送文件和图片吗？: Can I send files and images?
点击输入框旁的附件图标，或拖入文件、粘贴图片。支持 UTF-8 文本和代码文件，: Use the attachment button, drop files, or paste images. UTF-8 text and code files are supported; PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF need a vision model. Attach up to 8 files, 5 MB each and 10 MB total. PDF, Office, audio, video, and archives are not parsed. Attachments are sent to your model service and saved with the conversation.
无法打开或连接模型？: Can't open Pi Tab or connect to a model?
扩展用于普通 HTTP 和 HTTPS 网页，不支持本地文件、浏览器设置页或扩展: The extension supports regular HTTP/HTTPS pages, not local files, browser settings, or extension stores. Page security policies may block bookmarks, and bookmark model requests require CORS support. Extension requests run in the background. Check your endpoint, credentials, and model access if a connection fails.
基于 Pi Durable，在浏览器中运行 Pi Agent。支持书签、Chro: Run Pi Agent in your browser with Pi Durable. Use a bookmark or Chrome extension and keep your conversations.
基于 Pi Durable，通过书签或扩展打开，阅读、整理和操作当前网页。: Powered by Pi Durable. Open with a bookmark or extension to read, organize, and interact with the page.
填写模型信息，直接开始对话。: Set up your model and start chatting.
设置模型并试用 Pi Tab: Set up a model and try Pi Tab
模型密钥会保存在书签中，也可能随浏览器同步。请勿分享包含密钥的书签。: Your API key is saved in the bookmark and may sync with your browser. Do not share bookmarks containing keys.
复制下方地址，在浏览器的书签管理器中新建书签。填写名称，将地址粘贴到新书签的“网: Copy the URL below and create a bookmark in your browser's bookmark manager. Enter a name, paste the URL, and save.
得到 pi-tab-extension 文件夹。更新时替换原目录文件。: Locate the pi-tab-extension folder. To update, replace the files in the original folder.
点击“加载已解压的扩展程序”，选择 pi-tab-extension 文件夹，在: Choose “Load unpacked” and select the pi-tab-extension folder. On a regular webpage, click the Pi Tab toolbar icon and configure a model. After updating, reload the extension and refresh the page.
AI 可读取并操作页面，请在信任的网页使用。: AI can read and act on the page. Use it on trusted sites.

在对话窗口中提问或描述任务。空白书签需先配置模型。: Ask a question or describe a task. Unconfigured bookmarks need a model first.
本页配置会随书签保存。在其他网站修改的配置仅对该网站生效，不会改写书签。: Settings on this page are saved with the bookmark. Changes on other sites stay on those sites and do not update the bookmark.
